🥊 The Greatest (2026)
Long before the world called him a legend, he was Cassius Clay, a young boxer with a dream bigger than the ring. Driven by ambition and an unshakable belief in himself, he begins a journey that takes him from rising boxing talent to heavyweight champion and one of the most recognizable figures in sports history.
However, becoming the greatest means facing battles that no boxing match can prepare him for. From controversial decisions and personal sacrifices to standing up for his convictions, Muhammad Ali risks everything to remain true to himself. His courage, charisma, and determination transform him into a symbol of strength far beyond the sporting world.
This is the story of a champion whose greatest victories were not always measured by the punches he threw, but by the impact he left on generations.
Starring Jaalen Best, Omari Hardwick, Michael Ealy and Giovanni Ribisi.
